parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of autoreloader not tracking changes in manage.py, but it introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the autoreload logic.

issues.description: The patch introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the autoreload logic to explicitly include manage.py. This could have unintended side effects on other parts of the autoreload mechanism.
